events.name: Prime Day
events.source: Dates from Amazon announcements, later years by rule (second Tuesday of July, two days); uplift is an assumption.

events.name: Black Week
events.source: Black Friday to Cyber Monday; DHL sorted 12.4 million parcels on a Black Week day in 2025 against 6.7 million on a normal day (x1.85).

events.name: Singles' Day
events.source: Orders of 11 November reach German networks about a week later; Temu and Shein send about 460,000 parcels a day to Germany (Euronews 2026). Uplift is an assumption.
